context_interested_parties.title: Proposed interested parties
context_interested_parties.intro: Interested parties are the people and organisations that affect your business or are affected by it: customers, employees, owners, suppliers, authorities and so on. For each one you note what they need and expect from you, and how you follow it up.
context_interested_parties.promptBody: We can propose the interested parties that are typical for a business like yours, with their needs and expectations, based on your company profile and what you already have registered.

context_swot.title: Proposed SWOT analysis
context_swot.intro: A SWOT analysis is a simple way to describe your situation: strengths and weaknesses inside the business, opportunities and threats outside it. It helps you see what the management system must take care of.
context_swot.promptBody: We can draft a first SWOT analysis for your business, based on your company profile and what you already have registered.

context_scopes.title: Proposed scope
context_scopes.intro: The scope says what your management system covers: which activities, sites and services are included, where the boundaries are, and which requirements of a standard do not apply to you (with a reason).
context_scopes.promptBody: We can propose a scope for each standard you work with, based on your company profile, sites and processes.

context_responsibilities.title: Proposed roles and responsibilities
context_responsibilities.intro: Here you decide who does what in the management system. For each task, RACI shows who does the work (R), who is accountable (A, always exactly one), who is consulted (C) and who is kept informed (I). In a small company one person often holds several roles.
context_responsibilities.promptTitle: Shall I propose roles and responsibilities for you?
context_responsibilities.promptBody: We propose the usual responsibilities for the standards you work with, using your own people, roles and departments, and link them to your processes where they exist.

risk_risks.title: Proposed risks
risk_risks.intro: A risk is something that can go wrong and hurt your business, your employees, your customers or your information. For each risk you estimate how likely it is (likelihood) and how bad it would be (consequence), so you can deal with the most important ones first. The ratings here are suggestions: adjust them to your situation.
risk_risks.promptBody: We can propose the risks that are typical for a business like yours, with a first rating and suggested measures, and link them to your assets, processes and suppliers where they exist.

obligations_laws.title: Proposed laws and regulations
obligations_laws.whatTitle: Why a list of laws and regulations?
obligations_laws.intro: Every business must know which laws and regulations apply to it and check regularly that it follows them. This is required by the Internal Control Regulations and by the ISO standards. The proposals are a starting point: check that each one applies to you, and add any permits or contracts you have.
obligations_laws.promptBody: We can propose the laws and regulations that usually apply to a Norwegian business of your industry and size, with the main duties of each.

processes_map.title: Proposed processes
processes_map.intro: A process is a set of activities that turns something coming in (an order, a need) into something going out (a delivery, a decision). Core processes create value for your customers, management processes steer the business, and support processes make the rest possible. The map shows how your business works.
processes_map.promptBody: We can propose a process map with management, core and support processes, based on your industry and the standards you work with.

objectives_objectives.title: Proposed objectives
objectives_objectives.intro: A good objective is SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-bound. Each proposal has a target you can measure, a short plan and a deadline. The objectives are created as drafts, so management can approve them afterwards.
objectives_objectives.promptBody: We can propose a few SMART objectives for each standard you work with, based on your company profile.
